Radiant Industries, Inc.; Special Nuclear Materials License Application for a Fuel Packing Facility; Environmental Assessment and Finding of No Significant Impact

meta.abstract: The U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) is issuing a finding of no significant impact (FONSI) and accompanying environmental assessment (EA) regarding the NRC's consideration of a license application from Radiant Industries, Inc. (Radiant). Radiant is requesting a special nuclear material license for a facility in Oak Ridge, Tennessee. If granted, the license would allow Radiant to receive tri-structural isotropic (TRISO) particle fuel for fueling the Kaleidos self-contained, 1-megawatt electric reactors. This phase of the planned operational activities would only include packaging TRISO compacts into monoliths. Based on the EA, the NRC staff has concluded that there will be no significant impacts to environmental resources from the requested license, and therefore, a FONSI is appropriate.
